Finds the bodies of a physics world that touch a sphere. The bodies are kept in the order they were made; read them with `GetPhysicsOverlap` until the next overlap query.
@param x The middle of the sphere, x.
@param y The middle of the sphere, y.
@param z The middle of the sphere, z.
@param radius The radius, more than 0.
@param mask_low The layers to look at, as bits 0 to 31 of a mask (bit n is layer n). -1 (default) looks at all layers.
@param mask_high The layers 32 to 63, as bits 0 to 31 of a mask. -1 (default) looks at all layers.
@param sensors 1 also finds sensors (see `PhysicsSensor`); 0 (default) leaves them out.
@param world The physics world, 0 (default) for the default world.
@returns How many bodies touch the sphere.
@gap The original has no such command. This is an extension; programs that use it do not compile with the original Blitz3D.
